span.p: 5. Specialists run in parallel, each writing DeskEvents

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
intake
hydration path, one linted
Federato query, estimate_premium

hazard
picks layers per site,
skips with a reason,
search_precedent (Elastic)

portfolio
active TIV within 30 km,
H3 res-5 cell

appetite

div.style: color: rgb(18, 51, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. Submission arrives
World.case('SUB-138') reads the Federato snapshot
case.py:194

div.style: color: rgb(18, 51, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. Facts with provenance
TIV: Known, source 'Insured.hq → Location 19 → Buildings'
premium: Missing, resolver 'broker'
plus DataIssues: duplicate broker, stale, limit vs TIV

div.style: color: rgb(18, 51, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. Interval score, and the depth code demands
assess(case, property_2025.yaml): each factor contributes its own
min and max band points → ScoreInterval(lo, hi) + Decided | Open | Routed
depth_floor(): an open case or a blocking issue forces a deep dive,
and the Lead may raise that floor but never lower it

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. Lead plans the deep dive
one model call for the whole batch,
1-3 addressed briefs per case

div.style: color: rgb(18, 51, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
6. Fold, then hazard and portfolio adjustments
CaseFile.fold(events) → new facts + hazard multipliers
assess(case, rules, LayersPack, portfolio impact)
hazard points = -15 · ln(multiplier) / ln(1.25), total clamped 0.85-1.25
portfolio = -1 point per $25M of active TIV within 30 km, capped

div.style: color: rgb(18, 51, 36) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
7. Conflicts, detected in code, resolved by the Lead
detect_conflicts() reads typed outputs, not prose
the Lead may only pick from the allowed option list,
and code fills in the first allowed option if it picks outside

div.style: color: rgb(74, 58, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
8. Challenger, then the Lead's answer, then the gate
the Challenger argues against the draft and sizes 2-4 risks;
'what would change my mind' comes from the sensitivity analysis
the Lead answers every risk by name and may change the verdict
_gate_on_challenge() records any unanswered risk as unaddressed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
9. Decision and the stored view
accept / refer / decline / request_info, plus the explanation
apply_desk_run() rebuilds the QueueRow and CaseView, and the
waterfall, what-if and sensitivity all read the same numbers

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
10. Action
broker email (Composio Gmail), calendar hold, audit row in Sheets,
defect ticket, SMS digest or renter reply (Linq)
an outbox row per (case, action, facts) makes each one idempotent

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
11. Human replies, and the case is re-scored
broker email: a value is accepted only if the model can quote it
verbatim and the quote re-checks against the email
SMS: a tapback or 'accept 138' writes a human decision
the value becomes Known with the message id as its source,
assess() runs again at step 3 and the interval narrows on screen
